description: A stylish, environmentally friendly grocery bag dispenser for the contemporary home, keeping your kitchen and conscious clear!

This super trendy bag is the perfect addition to your kitchen, laundry or anywhere you find it necessary to store plastic bags. It is the ideal accessory for clutter free grocery bag storage. Simply hang the cotton drawstring over a door knob, a handle or a hook and place the used plastic bags in the top. Bags are conveniently retrieved by pulling them out of the bottom enclosure.
Since plastic bags do not biodegrade, this significantly decreases the amount of waste that goes into landfills which ultimately helps our ever so precious environment.
